November 1, 2024
To the Directors and Shareholders:

As we conclude our fiscal year, I wish to update you on our performance and provide a roadmap for the coming year. Despite market volatility and external challenges, our strategic initiatives and cost-saving measures have positioned us for continued growth and shareholder value creation.

We closed FY2024 with revenue of $27.3 billion, up 8% compared to 2023. Net earnings increased 14% to $3.7 billion, reflecting strong demand and smart cost management. Operating margins stood at 9.2%, up 130 basis points year-over-year, and debt levels dropped to $385 million, slightly lower than planned thanks to strategic efficiency programs.

Looking ahead, we are confident in our forecast for 2024-2025. We remain cautious regarding global economic headwinds and geopolitical risks but expect stable demand and continued focus on margin expansion. Our first-quarter guidance reaffirms our mid-to-top end of our earnings range, representing 4–6% year-on-year growth, supported by healthy cash flow generation and ongoing restructuring initiatives.

We will continue to prioritize disciplined capital allocation, with a focus on operational and working-capital optimization. This approach should enable us to remain competitive and deliver steady cash returns to our stakeholders.

We thank all of you for your partnership, confidence, and continued belief in Buckingham Intl. as we pursue our vision for long-term value creation. I encourage all of you to remain vigilant and focused as we navigate an increasingly dynamic global business environment and continue building for a stronger, more prosperous future.

Respectfully,

Michael S. Carter
President and CEO
Buckingham Intl. Corp.
November 15, 2024
